cafe.name: Brew & Co
cafe.subTagline: Single-origin roasts, 36-hour sourdough, and warm hospitality.

menuItems.name: Cappuccino
menuItems.description: Velvety espresso with steamed milk foam and organic cocoa dust.

menuItems.name: Cold Coffee
menuItems.description: Creamy blended iced brew with vanilla bean gelato scoop.

menuItems.name: Espresso Single / Double
menuItems.description: Single origin Arabica bean extract with thick golden crema.

menuItems.name: Cold Brew Reserve
menuItems.description: Steeped for 18 hours in cold filtered spring water. Smooth and low acidity.

menuItems.name: Spanish Latte
menuItems.description: Espresso balanced with condensed milk and steamed whole milk.

menuItems.name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich
menuItems.description: Char-grilled cottage cheese in sourdough bread with mint chutney.

menuItems.name: Artisan Margherita Pizza
menuItems.description: Hand-stretched sourdough crust, San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella.

menuItems.name: Grilled Herb Sandwich
menuItems.description: Zucchini, bell peppers, melted cheddar and herb butter on multigrain.

menuItems.name: Falafel Veggie Wrap
menuItems.description: Crispy herb falafels, pickled cucumbers, hummus and tahini garlic dressing.

menuItems.name: Belgian Chocolate Cake
menuItems.description: Rich 70% dark chocolate mousse layers with sea salt ganache.

menuItems.name: New York Cheesecake
menuItems.description: Classic baked cream cheese slice over crunchy graham cracker base.

menuItems.name: Blueberry Crumble Muffin
menuItems.description: Fresh wild blueberries baked into fluffy buttermilk muffin crown.

menuItems.name: Kolkata Masala Chai
menuItems.description: Slow-simmered Assam CTC tea leaves with fresh ginger, cardamom & clove.

menuItems.name: Organic Jasmine Green Tea
menuItems.description: Delicate whole-leaf green tea scented with pure night-blooming jasmine flowers.

menuItems.name: Fresh Mint Lime Soda
menuItems.description: Fresh squeezed Persian limes with crushed garden mint and sparkling soda.

menuItems.name: Classic Veg Burger
menuItems.description: Crisp spiced potato patty with house sauce, lettuce and brioche bun.

customers.name: Priya Sharma
customers.notes: Always prefers lactose-free milk or oat milk.

customers.name: Arjun Mehta
customers.notes: Loves iced cold brews and Margherita pizza.

reviews.author: Anjali Kapoor
reviews.text: Outstanding artisanal coffee! The Spanish Latte and Belgian chocolate cake are to die for.

reviews.reply: Thank you so much Anjali! It is always a pleasure having you at Brew & Co.
